item.title: Remembering Irish singer–songwriter Glen Hansard
item.description: Best-known for his band The Frames and his part in the 2007 film Once, Hansard got his start as a street busker in Dublin. He died July 29 in a motorcycle crash. Originally broadcast in 2008.

item.title: Celebrating Tony Bennett on what would have been his 100th birthday
item.description: Bennett, who died in 2023, was known for a string of hits, including "I Left My Heart in San Francisco." Kevin Whitehead offers an appreciation and remembers some of Bennett's lesser-known songs.
